scene.visual_brief: انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای؛ تصمیم‌های طراحی آبیاری | انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای | آشنایی با انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره‌ای، نکات طراحی، فاصله خروجی‌ها و انتخاب مناسب بر اساس شرایط مزرعه. راهنمای کاربردی وبلاگ آموزشی AFP. | مقدمه انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای نقش کلیدی در برنامه‌ریزی آبیاری و نیازسنجی مزرعه دارند. پیش از هر تصمیم طراحی، شناخت عملکرد فشار، فاصله خروجی‌ها و ظرفیت دبی هر مدل ضروری است، چرا که خطا در این مرحله مستقیماً بر یکنواختی توزیع آب و راندمان آبیاری تأثیر می‌گذارد. در این مقاله آموزشی انواع نوار تیپ آبیاری قطره ای بررسی شده و نکات فنی لازم برای انتخاب دقیق بر اساس مشخصات برگه سازنده ارائه می‌شود. انواع اصلی نوار تیپ

The supplied reference depicts the ONLY commercial package to appear; do not depict before/after products or a product comparison. RIGHT half, main subject: neutral small seedlings, continuous thin flattened installed drip-tape laterals and localized root-zone wetting. Preserve the supplied sidewall proportions. Angle tiny secondary print away from the camera rather than inventing lettering. Show the full carton base, natural contact shadow, clear frame margins and a visible strip of bare soil around the complete footprint. Its exterior silhouette is clean and self-contained, without attachments. All contents remain entirely INSIDE the single carton. All operating irrigation tape is separate thin BLACK flattened flexible tape in the planted bed on the RIGHT. 20 cm denotes emitter spacing along tape, not tape width or pipe diameter. No people, hands, captions, collage, extra package, loose commercial coil, or white ribbon outside the carton. Final scene layout: exactly ONE complete closed AFP carton on LEFT soil; neutral small seedlings, continuous thin flattened installed drip-tape laterals and localized root-zone wetting on RIGHT; visible empty soil between them. No line behind the carton or underneath it. The one carton is a retail package, never functioning plumbing.

primary_review.reasons: The candidate shows exactly one recognizable AFP drip-tape carton roll with authentic, readable 'AFP' and 'Drip Irrigation Tape' branding, matching the reference identity. The installed scene includes neutral seedlings and thin flattened drip laterals running along the soil bed, aligning with the agromony article topic. The required 'AFP | 09134922013' watermark is present and clear. Minor soil-shape details and ordinary line contact are advisory and do not impair a useful coherent illustration. No wrong product, mixed family, fake branding, impossible geometry, people, collage, or crop contradiction is observed.

independent_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation line passes directly in front of and immediately adjacent to the base of the package, and a dark tube emerges from the left side of the package base lying on the soil. A white strip/tail is clearly protruding and lying on the soil in front of the package on the left side. No distinct extra loose coils are visible; only the required package and continuous lateral lines are present.
